trainers.instruction: Read and listen to the poem.

atoms.text:
I am going to wake-up,
And take a sip from my cup.
I shouldn’t go back to bed,
But can I just hit snooze instead?

A morning of maths back at school,
Now at lunch, it’s time to refuel.
The cafeteria food looks alive,
My appetite takes a nosedive.

Finally, the bell is about to ring,
And I’d like to go play on the swing.
Soon I am back home once more,
So much learning, my brain is sore.

Today was just a normal day,
But, I’d really like to say,
I am so happy to be here,
Every day to me is dear!
